Committed BEFORE any scorer run on the new code. Read-record: coa-expected/read-record-chat164.json, 32 figures on 25 golden cases (13 lots with an area, frontage or depth figure, plus corner figures on 22 lots). Derivation (no scorer run on the new code): a class can only move on a row whose input changes, so only lots whose read figure differs from the parcel figure used today can move; of the 32 figures, all 17 corner reads equal the parcel corner (no change), 12 area/dimension reads differ from the parcel by under 1 % (value changes only, class moves not expected) and 3 differ by more (A0388 area +8.67 %, A0561 area +2.80 %, A0578 area +7.66 %). Every row on A0388 and A0561 is already MATCH or OWED, so no class move is asserted. TIER A (expected class moves, causal link known): none. The plan tier A item A0562#4 (NO ANSWER -> DATA on a corner read true) is WITHDRAWN: the keyed value for that lot is not a corner (golden none, confirmed), it contradicts the held corner true, the keyed value is read, and the parcel already holds not-corner, so nothing changes; the NO ANSWER cause on A0562#4/#5 is clause keying, not the lot figure. TIER A value change (class stays MATCH): A0170/26EYK#2 900.3.10(38)(A) gfa_m2 243.47 -> 244 (area 488 read, 0.5 x 488). TIER B (conditional, not asserted; if it moves it moves this way only): A0578/26TEY#1 900.3.10(1397)(A)(i) DIFFER -> MATCH, only if its gap is area-driven (area 345.22 read against parcel 320.66); not otherwise expected. TIER C (expected NOT to move, watch): the listed NO ANSWER and DIFFER rows on read lots. Every other row moving is a finding. Floors: nothing is expected to lift and none may fall (M-322); the 172-set line 10.5.50 answered (81.4 < 83) is NOT expected to lift because A0562#4/#5 and A0277#4/#5 are clause-keying NO ANSWER rows. The six cumulative-set failing lines are re-measured on the cumulative set with the same expectation (totals unchanged). No tolerances, no allowlists (CHAT-193).
